name: Corastra
source:
A mysterious roguish maiden found wandering the roads of Dongdor. Few know much about this buxom woman. What is apparent based on her actions and speech is that she is well-trained in both body and mind, and that there is more to her than she's willing to initially reveal.

[From The Anal Forest in-game profile]
